notes.file: Paths are relative to 'root'. 'variants' lists interchangeable files to randomise between (empty = single file).
notes.loudness: loudnessLufs is momentary-max (400 ms) for one-shots and integrated for loops (BS.1770 K-weighting).
notes.suggested: volume = Sound.Volume; rollOff*Studs = RollOffMinDistance/RollOffMaxDistance (InverseTapered); null for 2D sounds.
notes.banks: One-shots are also packed into 'banks' (upload-quota friendly). bankRegions[i] matches variants[i] (or 'file'); play with AudioPlayer.PlaybackRegion = NumberRange.new(startS, endS). Loops are never banked.

armor_blocked.description: NON-PENETRATION: dull, short, low-mid clang with a thud.
armor_blocked.event: Shell hits but does not penetrate (blocked / absorbed by spaced armor).

armor_critical.description: CRITICAL MODULE HIT: razor snap, electric zap, arcing buzz and sparks.
armor_critical.event: Penetration that damages a module or crew (plays with/after the penetration cue).

armor_hit_taken_blocked.description: HIT TAKEN (inside, blocked): muffled thud and ringing hull bong.

armor_hit_taken_pen.description: HIT TAKEN (inside, penetrated): muffled heavy thud, hull bong, interior crunch.
armor_hit_taken_pen.event: Own vehicle penetrated (2D, interior perspective; duck Vehicles/Ambience).

armor_hit_taken_ricochet.description: HIT TAKEN (inside, ricochet): glancing thud, bright hull ring, muffled whine.

armor_penetration.description: PENETRATION: heavy boom, dense metal crunch and a tearing metal sweep.
armor_penetration.event: Shell penetrates a vehicle (shooter hears it 2D at priority 95; others positional).

armor_ricochet.description: RICOCHET: bright high ping and a falling, tumbling whine.

cue_ally_destroyed.description: Somber falling D4-A3 muted brass with low thud.

cue_capture_complete.description: Drum, D power-chord brass and bell.

cue_capture_warning_loop.event: Your base is being captured (loop while capture points > 0).

cue_enemy_destroyed.description: Punchy rising fifth A4-E5 with snap.
cue_enemy_destroyed.event: Enemy destroyed (louder variant when it was your kill: +3 dB).

cue_enemy_spotted.event: An enemy is newly spotted by your team.

cue_low_hp_heartbeat_loop.event: Own HP below 15 % (volume rises as HP falls).

cue_sixth_sense.description: SPOTTED WARNING: original ominous 3-note motif (A4, D#5, D5 held) over a low drone.
cue_sixth_sense.event: Own vehicle has been spotted by the enemy (highest-priority cue; ducks everything else ~4 dB).

hangar_compressor_cycle.description: Air compressor run cycle ending in a pressure-release hiss.

hangar_distant_tools.description: Distant workshop tools in hangar reverb (a impact wrench, b hammer on metal, c ratchet).

hangar_pa_chime.description: PA tone chime through a loudspeaker band in hangar reverb (a rising, b falling). No speech.
hangar_pa_chime.event: Garage: before/after notifications such as 'battle found' or events (2D).

hangar_room_tone.description: Large hangar room tone: HVAC air, mains hum, faint lamp buzz, distant activity in a big metal room.

impact_concrete.description: Shell ground impact on concrete: crack, crumble, dust and a rebar ping.
impact_concrete.event: Shell (any type) hits terrain/prop of material 'concrete' (HE adds its explosion layer separately if desired).

impact_dirt.description: Shell ground impact on earth: thump, soil clods and long dirt patter.
impact_dirt.event: Shell (any type) hits terrain/prop of material 'dirt' (HE adds its explosion layer separately if desired).

impact_metal_building.description: Shell ground impact on sheet-metal structure: big wobbling clang and rattle.
impact_metal_building.event: Shell (any type) hits terrain/prop of material 'metal_building' (HE adds its explosion layer separately if desired).

impact_rock.description: Shell ground impact on rock: sharp crack and stone chips.
impact_rock.event: Shell (any type) hits terrain/prop of material 'rock' (HE adds its explosion layer separately if desired).

impact_sand.description: Shell ground impact on sand: thump and hissing sand shower.
impact_sand.event: Shell (any type) hits terrain/prop of material 'sand' (HE adds its explosion layer separately if desired).

impact_snow.description: Shell ground impact on snow: muffled thump and soft powder 'poof'.
impact_snow.event: Shell (any type) hits terrain/prop of material 'snow' (HE adds its explosion layer separately if desired).

impact_water.description: Shell ground impact on water: plunge, splash spray, bubble cluster and falling droplets.
impact_water.event: Shell (any type) hits terrain/prop of material 'water' (HE adds its explosion layer separately if desired).

impact_wood.description: Shell ground impact on wood: splintering crack and timber debris.
impact_wood.event: Shell (any type) hits terrain/prop of material 'wood' (HE adds its explosion layer separately if desired).

radio_cmd_attack.description: Radio quick command: Attack! - three fast rising beeps (chirp, static, tones, squelch; no speech).
radio_cmd_attack.event: Teammate issues the 'attack' quick command (pair with minimap ping).

radio_cmd_capture.description: Radio quick command: Capture the base! - long-short-long rising (chirp, static, tones, squelch; no speech).
radio_cmd_capture.event: Teammate issues the 'capture' quick command (pair with minimap ping).

radio_cmd_defend.description: Radio quick command: Defend the base! - two long low tones (chirp, static, tones, squelch; no speech).
radio_cmd_defend.event: Teammate issues the 'defend' quick command (pair with minimap ping).

radio_cmd_follow.description: Radio quick command: Follow me! - up-down pairs (chirp, static, tones, squelch; no speech).
radio_cmd_follow.event: Teammate issues the 'follow' quick command (pair with minimap ping).

radio_cmd_help.description: Radio quick command: Help! - rapid alternating hi-lo (chirp, static, tones, squelch; no speech).
radio_cmd_help.event: Teammate issues the 'help' quick command (pair with minimap ping).

radio_cmd_retreat.description: Radio quick command: Fall back! - three descending tones (chirp, static, tones, squelch; no speech).
radio_cmd_retreat.event: Teammate issues the 'retreat' quick command (pair with minimap ping).

radio_cmd_spotted.description: Radio quick command: Enemy spotted - ping and two short beeps (chirp, static, tones, squelch; no speech).
radio_cmd_spotted.event: Teammate issues the 'spotted' quick command (pair with minimap ping).

radio_static.description: Radio static burst with squelch tail.
radio_static.event: Generic radio chatter texture / comms noise.

reload_autoloader_cycle.description: Autoloader: carousel ratchet, rammer slam, breech close, lock.
reload_autoloader_cycle.event: Autoloader cycles a round (single-shot autoloaders, between drum shots).

reload_breech_close.description: Sliding breech block: slide, heavy chunk, latch click.
reload_breech_close.event: Breech closes at the end of a manual reload.

reload_dual_gun_ready.description: Two crisp latch clicks and a tick: both barrels ready.

reload_magazine_sequence.description: Full magazine/drum reload sequence (release, rotate, 4 rounds, lock, ready).
reload_magazine_sequence.event: Drum/magazine refill started (length ~3.9 s; stretch timing by playing in segments if the reload is longer).

reload_shell_clank.description: Brass shell case knocking steel during loading.
reload_shell_clank.event: Manual loader handling a round (own vehicle, interior perspective).

shell_distant_thump.description: Very distant gun report: dark thump with valley echo.
shell_distant_thump.event: Shot fired beyond the far band (>1.2 km) or from unspotted artillery.

shell_flyby_ap.description: Supersonic AP near miss: shock crack then tearing whoosh with Doppler drop.
shell_flyby_ap.event: Enemy kinetic round passes within ~15 m of the listener.

meta.note: start playback closestApproachS before the round's closest approach

shell_flyby_he.description: HE/HEAT near miss: lower fluttering whoosh, no crack.
shell_flyby_he.event: Enemy HE/HEAT round passes within ~15 m of the listener.

meta.note: start playback closestApproachS before the round's closest approach

shell_whistle_artillery.event: Artillery shell inbound near listener; ends right before impact (schedule impact at file end).

track_broken_clatter.description: Track snaps and links flail, slap the ground and drag.
track_broken_clatter.event: Track module destroyed while moving (pairs with dmg_track_broken).

track_concrete.description: Tracks on hard paving: bright clatter and scrape (native 25 km/h).
track_concrete.event: Vehicle moving on 'concrete' material (PlaybackSpeed = speed/25 km/h, 0.5-1.6x; volume follows speed).

track_dirt.description: Tracks on packed earth: crunchy soil, solid rumble (native 25 km/h).
track_dirt.event: Vehicle moving on 'dirt' material (PlaybackSpeed = speed/25 km/h, 0.5-1.6x; volume follows speed).

track_grass.description: Tracks on turf: soft swish and rustle, damped clank (native 25 km/h).
track_grass.event: Vehicle moving on 'grass' material (PlaybackSpeed = speed/25 km/h, 0.5-1.6x; volume follows speed).

track_gravel.description: Tracks on loose stones: dense granular crunch (native 25 km/h).
track_gravel.event: Vehicle moving on 'gravel' material (PlaybackSpeed = speed/25 km/h, 0.5-1.6x; volume follows speed).

track_metal.description: Tracks on steel deck: ringing plate and clang (native 25 km/h).
track_metal.event: Vehicle moving on 'metal' material (PlaybackSpeed = speed/25 km/h, 0.5-1.6x; volume follows speed).

track_mud.description: Tracks on deep mud: squelch, suction, wet splats (native 25 km/h).
track_mud.event: Vehicle moving on 'mud' material (PlaybackSpeed = speed/25 km/h, 0.5-1.6x; volume follows speed).

track_sand.description: Tracks on sand: hiss and pour, muffled clank (native 25 km/h).
track_sand.event: Vehicle moving on 'sand' material (PlaybackSpeed = speed/25 km/h, 0.5-1.6x; volume follows speed).

track_snow.description: Tracks on packed snow: squeaky crunch, muffled (native 25 km/h).
track_snow.event: Vehicle moving on 'snow' material (PlaybackSpeed = speed/25 km/h, 0.5-1.6x; volume follows speed).

track_squeal.event: Sharp turns / pivot steering / braking at speed (rate-limited, random variant).

track_water.description: Tracks on wading: slosh, bubbles and splashes (native 25 km/h).
track_water.event: Vehicle moving on 'water' material (PlaybackSpeed = speed/25 km/h, 0.5-1.6x; volume follows speed).

track_wood.description: Tracks on timber bridge: hollow plank knocks and creaks (native 25 km/h).
track_wood.event: Vehicle moving on 'wood' material (PlaybackSpeed = speed/25 km/h, 0.5-1.6x; volume follows speed).

transmission_gear_shift.description: Gear change clunk with clutch air.

transmission_reverse_whine.event: Layered while driving in reverse (PlaybackSpeed tracks speed).

turret_traverse_large.description: Hydraulic turret traverse drive with ring-gear rumble (heavy turrets).

turret_traverse_start.description: Traverse engage: relay click, gear clunk, motor spin-up.

turret_traverse_stop.description: Traverse stop: spin-down and brake clunk.

ui_achievement_unlocked.description: Sparkly fast bell arpeggio with shimmer and pad.

ui_back.description: Soft click plus falling fifth, darker.

ui_battle_found.description: Drum hit, rising tone, D-minor brass stab.

ui_countdown_go.description: Bright A tone with drum and whoosh.

ui_hover.event: Pointer/selection moves onto an interactive element.

ui_level_up.description: Riser into a rising arpeggio and pad.

ui_purchase.description: Military 'cash register': stamp, latch, coin-like ching.

ui_research_complete.description: Rising D-major bell arpeggio over a soft pad.

ui_vehicle_unlocked.description: Fanfare-lite: brass motif A-D-F#-A with timpani.

wx_rain_loop.description: Rain: hiss bed, dense droplets, puddle plinks, low wash.

wx_sandstorm_loop.description: Sandstorm: roaring gusts, heavy sand hiss and grit, buffeting.

wx_snowstorm_loop.description: Snowstorm: howling whistling gusts, snow hiss, buffeting.

wx_thunder.description: Thunder: a = close strike (crackle + crack + roll), b = mid roll, c = distant rumble.
wx_thunder.event: Storm weather: random every 15-60 s (a rarely).
